The bill would also impose taxes on the cannabis industry and use the revenues to fund critical programs to support those who were negatively impacted by the criminalization of marijuana. 

These programs will support job training, substance-use disorders treatment, and more. 2/3

Federal firefighters serve the same people & fight the same fires as local firefighters, yet they don’t receive the same health protections when facing work-related health risks like cancer.

I voted for the Federal Firefighters Fairness Act to fix that & ensure equal treatment.

Heads up! Tomorrow at 9am, the Sonoma County Department of Emergency Management is holding an evacuation EXERCISE in Diamond A & Grove Street neighborhoods of Sonoma (evacuation zone 6D1).

If in this zone, listen for the high/low siren and evacuate to Sonoma Valley High School.

Today is the primary election in California! Voting is the most vital tool in our democracy, and I encourage every Californian to get out and exercise their right to vote.

Visit @CASOSVote website for info on how to vote: https://t.co/yOLF0V16I8

Operation Fly Formula is delivering essential nutrition to the United States and our children.

We are getting baby formula back onto shelves.

https://t.co/r78bLuEBHc

The Santa Rosa Laguna Wastewater Treatment Plant provides vital services to our communities in Sonoma County.
 
This facility pumps wastewater to CalPine geothermal plants to produce renewable energy and provide this energy to Lake, Sonoma, and Mendocino counties. https://t.co/6S7dDaCLGb

Today, @POTUS signed the Honoring Our PACT Act to provide millions of veterans living with the effects of toxic exposure the care they earned from @DeptVetAffairs.

Our veterans answered the call to serve our nation, and the PACT Act will ensure they get the treatment they need.

Congrats to SOMO Village on their Unity Festival 2022! This festival highlighted the quality of holistic health and wellness and showcased over 70 vendors and practitioners.
 
From healing to mediation to yoga and dance, this was a great event for the community to come together. https://t.co/sJjoJO6RNO

My thoughts are with my friends & former constituents in Humboldt County as they respond to the magnitude 6.4 earthquake.
 
CalTrans is on scene evaluating damages to roads & @HumCoOES is advising to check gas & water lines for damages or leaks & to exercise caution if traveling.

My thoughts are with @RepRaskin and his family as he begins treatment for his cancer diagnosis.

Jamie is a fighter and I know he can get through this. Wishing him nothing but the best and hoping for a swift recovery.
Digital therapeutics have been shown to improve outcomes for people struggling with mental health issues, making clear the importance of alternative treatment methods.

Heartbreaking to hear of yet another case of senseless gun violence in our country as a man in Texas murdered 5 people, including an 8-year-old, after being asked to stop shooting so children could sleep.

https://t.co/PskO0YH5wH
Happy Bike to Work Day! Cycling is a great way to get outside and get exercise, and I encourage everyone to opt for a bike today. https://t.co/p2zBMWV6Yf

@WaysMeansCmte That means:

$60B in tax cuts for the wealthiest 20% of Americans
$1.4B in tax cuts for the poorest 20% of Americans
$23.8B for foreign investors

The bills we are marking up are fiscally irresponsible and patently unfair, and this exercise is the height of hypocrisy. 2/2

The #988Lifeline provides 24/7 support to people struggling with mental health or thinking about suicide.
 
In 1 year, nearly 5M contacted the line. 1 in 20 adults experience a serious mental illness each year, and less than 2/3 receive treatment. 988 is helping to save lives.
Jan and I send our thoughts and prayers to @SteveScalise in the wake of his cancer diagnosis. Steve is a fighter and will come out stronger on the other side. Get well soon!

September is Suicide Prevention Awareness Month. This month, we remember those affected by suicide & work to expand access to mental health treatment for those who need it.
 
If you or a loved one is struggling, call or text 988 for free, confidential help — you are not alone. https://t.co/o1zgZ5Ry3K

We are 2 days away from extreme MAGA Republicans forcing a government shutdown which would cut nutrition assistance from women and children, force servicemembers to go without pay, and throw airports and travel into chaos.

The American people deserve more.

Extreme MAGA GOP's short-term funding bill would slash many programs by 29%, fire teachers & FBI agents, cut nutrition assistance for women & kids, and fails to support communities recovering from natural disasters.

This bill is misguided and would be a disaster for our country.

Today, the Military Veterans Caucus met with mental health experts to discuss the importance of mental health care for our veterans.

Better understanding the causes of mental health issues will help us develop better treatment options for those impacted. https://t.co/MJs4vPRREU

If a handful of MAGA Republicans force a government shutdown, our district would hurt:

✅ Over 14,000 kids would lose access to nutrition benefits
✅ Over 7,100 federal workers would be furloughed
✅ Small businesses would suffer

We can't afford a MAGA Republican shutdown. https://t.co/mDalnIRNzT

Taking on mental health is important to taking on many of the challenges our country faces, such as homelessness and substance abuse.

My Mental Health Research Accelerator Act will help us address the causes of mental health rather than just treat the symptoms.

The proposed PGA-LIV merger raises serious concerns. Nonprofit tax treatment should be reserved for institutions and charities that help everyday Americans – not billion-dollar sports leagues backed by Saudi government money.

Today, @VP announced $285M from the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act to help hire and train school mental health counselors to assist in the diagnosis and treatment of mental health issues.
 
This funding will help reduce gun violence and keep us safe.
Great to get my colleagues out for a morning ride this #BikeToWorkDay. There’s no better way to get exercise and reduce our carbon footprint—the bike is the cure! https://t.co/21rMpApZG3
